title: Single Cell Spatial Proteomics LC-MS/MS Analysis of Mouse Brain Tissue
author: Marion Pang
materials: The LC system (Vanquish Neo UHPLC, Thermo Scientific) was coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) with a Nanospray Flex ion source (Thermo Scientific).

Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was carried out in positive ion mode using a positive ion voltage of 1600 V while maintaining the ion transfer tube at a temperature of 300 °C . The maximum injection time was set to auto, and the normalized AGC target was set to 300%. Precursor ions with charges ranging from +2 to +6 were selectively targeted for fragmentation using a minimum intensity threshold of 5e3. Dynamic exclusion was set to exclude after one acquisition, with a 45-second exclusion duration and 10 ppm mass tolerance. MS2 scans were acquired in the Orbitrap at 60000 resolutions with an isolation window of 1.6 m/z, HCD collision energy set at 28%, and an auto-adjusted maximum injection time. The normalized AGC target was set at 200%. Xcalibur software (Thermo Scientific) was used for method implementation and data acquisition.
Xcalibur software (Thermo Scientific) was used for method implementation and data acquisition.

For best recovery of samples, add 5 µL of lysis buffer ( 0.2 Mass / % volume n-Dodecyl-beta-Maltoside Detergent Thermo Fisher Catalog #89902 in 50 millimolar (mM) Triethylammonium Bicarbonate Thermo Scientific Catalog #90114 ) to each tube, then votex in an inverted position for 30s.
The LC system (Vanquish Neo UHPLC, Thermo Scientific) was coupled to an Orbitrap Astral mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) with a EasySpray ion source (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Mount Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Mount tissue sections on a PET membrane metal frame slide (RNAse free, Leica #76463-322).

steps.title: Excise Regions of Interest
steps.instruction: Excise regions of interest from mounted tissues using a gravity-driven collection system with a Leica LMD7000 or Leica LMD7 (Software Version V8.4).

substeps.instruction: For LMD7000 20x magnification: Power 55, Aperture 3, Speed 3, Specimen balance 15, Line spacing 15, Head current 100%, Pulse frequency 1510, Offset 115.
For LMD7000 40x magnification: Power 24, Aperture 1, Speed 12, Specimen balance 12, Line spacing 19, Head current 100%, Pulse frequency 1046, Offset 180.
For LMD7 40x magnification: Power 45, Aperture 1, Speed 25, Specimen balance 15, Line spacing 19, Head current 100%, Pulse frequency 519, Offset 180.

steps.title: Collect and Lyse Tissue
steps.instruction: Collect dissected tissue into the cap of a 0.65 mL Sorenson SafeSeal Low Binding Tube containing 10 µL of lysis buffer (50 mM Triethylammonium Bicarbonate, Thermo Scientific #90114 and 0.2 Mass/% volume n-Dodecyl-beta-Maltoside, Thermo Scientific #89903).

substeps.instruction: Visually verify that the dissected tissue has landed on the cap.
Vortex the tube upside down for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge the tubes at 13000 x g, 25 °C, for 1 minute.
Store samples at -80 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Digestion
steps.instruction: Thaw samples from -80 °C to room temperature and prepare for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13000 x g, room temperature, for 1 minute.
Transfer samples into a LoBind 384 well PCR plate (Eppendorf 0030129547).
Incubate in a PCR machine at 70 °C for 1 hour (0 rpm) with the lid set to 85 °C.

steps.title: Perform Protease Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins using a protease mix and quench the reaction.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 1000 x g, room temperature, for 1 minute and cool to room temperature.
Add 1 µL of protease digestion mix (4 ng Trypsin, Promega #V5280 and 4 ng Lys-C, Wako #125-05061) to each well.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C overnight.
Centrifuge the plate at 1000 x g, room temperature, for 1 minute.
Quench digestion by adding 0.5 µL of aqueous buffer (2% volume Acetonitrile, Thermo Fisher #51101 and 4% volume Formic acid, Thermo Fisher #28905).

steps.title: LC-MS/MS Analysis (Option 1)
steps.instruction: Perform LC-MS/MS analysis using the first configuration.

substeps.instruction: Separate peptides on an Aurora Ultimate UHPLC Column (25cm x 75µm) maintained at 50 °C.
Load 5 µL of sample per well onto the column.
Set separation gradient flow rate to 0.22 µL/min with an analytical duration of 01:00:00.

Run DIA acquisition in positive ion mode: positive ion voltage 1600 V, ion transfer tube 300 °C, MS1 full scans (375-1200 m/z, resolution 120000, normalized AGC target 300%, max injection time auto), MS2 scans (resolution 60000, max injection time 118 ms, AGC target 75%).

steps.title: LC-MS/MS Analysis (Option 2)
steps.instruction: Perform LC-MS/MS analysis using the second configuration.

substeps.instruction: Separate peptides on an Aurora Ultimate UHPLC Column (25cm x 75µm) maintained at 55 °C.
Load 12 µL of sample per well onto the column.
Set separation gradient flow rate to 0.22 µL/min with an analytical duration of 00:20:00.

Run DIA acquisition in positive ion mode: positive ion voltage 1800 V, ion transfer tube 275 °C, full scans (400-800 m/z, resolution 240000, max injection time 100ms, normalized AGC target 500%), MS2 scans (20m/z isolation windows, 400-800 m/z range, 0.6s duty cycle, normalized HCD collision energy 25%, max injection time 80 ms, AGC target 800%).
